limitations: 4 bytes outside known signing fields were not interpreted; suffixes do not by themselves establish malformed signing.
Static structural inspection only. No Android code executes, no device or adb is involved, and odex/vdex/oat/cdex are not read.

No signature is verified: signer, rotation-lineage and source-stamp signatures are NOT cryptographically checked, and certificate chains, revocation and authenticity are NOT evaluated. Certificates and lineages are what the APK declares.

matches_apk and self_consistent only show that the declared content digest equals the digest of the current bytes. This is not a signature verification: anyone who changes the bytes can recompute the digest and write it into the signed data. SHA-256 identifies the exact bytes, not the producer.
v1 signers are what each signature block's PKCS#7 SignedData declares: its signatures, the .SF and MANIFEST.MF digests and entry coverage are NOT verified.
Not read: v4 .apk.idsig, verity digests (matches_apk null), and the v1 X-Android-APK-Signed marker, so v1_only cannot distinguish a v1-only APK from one whose v2/v3 block was removed.
The APK is read through an owned read-only snapshot; concurrent changes to the original cannot mix into this observation
The snapshot hash identifies a Dart SDK build only against an external mapping dataset; REA performs no lookup
Release engine builds often carry no labeled Dart version string; absence is reported, not guessed
Engine build IDs come only from ELF-declared PT_NOTE/SHT_NOTE records; conflicting or incompletely examined notes preserve candidates and report partial coverage
The snapshot hash sits 20 bytes after each snapshot magic in the AOT payload; findings are observations of that layout
ELF header validity checks the supported header layout and declared table extents; identification does not resolve symbols or validate table contents

lib/armeabi-v7a/libapp.so carries 1 observed snapshot header(s); complete coverage of the supported legacy split VM/isolate profile requires two independent sources. Unified and other layouts remain unverified
